svg.title: Sensor coverage versus downtime Pareto
svg.desc: Animated grid of twenty assets. Eight have sensors with live traces; twelve are estimated. The downtime Pareto overlay ranks five assets, showing that most of the top-ranked assets lack sensors, so the plan is to instrument them or fall back to thresholds and inspection rounds.

g.text: Where the sensors are vs where downtime is
Start with the sensors you have
40% of assets carry sensors today. The other 60% get inferred
risk from usage patterns and batch failure history, always
shown with uncertainty and a low-confidence label.
Day 1 to 30 gate: rank assets by the downtime they cause,
then check whether sensors sit on those assets.
In this illustration, only 1 of the top 5 is covered.
Quote and instrument the top-ranked assets, or fall back to
thresholds and inspection rounds, labelled low confidence.
ML is used only where the data supports it.
gap: instrument first, or use thresholds and rounds
